guide.config.name: Lucent Client
guide.config.welcome.title: Make Lucent yours
guide.config.welcome.body: Walk through the real menu, one control at a time. Your settings stay yours to choose. Skip guide or Esc ends this tour and saves that choice.
guide.config.menu.title: Open your menu
guide.config.menu.body: Press {menuKey} to open the HUD editor. Right Shift is the default; this hint follows your key binding.
guide.config.mods.title: Find your mods
guide.config.mods.body: Click Mods in the middle of the HUD editor to open ConfigScreen.
guide.config.search.title: Find a feature
guide.config.search.body: Click the highlighted search field and type part of a mod name. Try a name visible in the list. Clear the text to see all mods again.
guide.config.settings.title: Look inside a mod
guide.config.settings.body: Click the gear at the bottom right of a mod card. The card switches a mod on or off; the gear opens its detailed settings.
guide.config.preferences.title: Tune the interface
guide.config.preferences.body: Open Preferences in the sidebar. Language, interface scale and animation settings live here. Choose what suits you.
guide.config.profiles.title: Keep different setups
guide.config.profiles.body: Open Profiles. You can save separate configurations and switch between them here. You do not need to create one for this tour.
guide.config.themes.title: Choose your theme
guide.config.themes.body: Open Themes to see the available appearances. A theme changes the menu's appearance; you can keep your current choice.
guide.config.done.title: Your menu, within reach
guide.config.done.body: You now know where to search, open settings and manage profiles and themes. Press {menuKey} whenever you want to return.
lucent.config.title: Lucent Config
lucent.preferences.language.desc: Changes the language of the UI.
lucent.preferences.open_animation.desc: Toggles the opening animation of the config screen.
lucent.preferences.ui_blur.desc: Enables a blur effect behind the UI.
lucent.preferences.ui_blur_strength.desc: Adjusts the strength of the UI blur.
lucent.preferences.ui_scale.desc: Adjusts the scale of the configuration interface.
lucent.preferences.play_notification_sou: Plays a sound when a notification is displayed.
lucent.config.lucent.translucent3drender: Fixes translucent custom geometry rendering after terrain.
Renders translucent custom geometry after terrain rendering.
